title: After foreign patients leave Korea, aftercare goes untracked
caption:
South Korea invested 1.48 billion won into remote care for visiting surgery patients, but parliamentary records show zero tracking of dropouts. Clinics satisfied quotas using pre-departure consultations alone. Without field audits, health authorities cannot confirm whether overseas travelers ever received post-operative care.

Source: Koreaherald - After foreign patients leave Korea, aftercare goes untracked
